newsitem.title: USA: Woodhead Industries posts record Q2 net. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Woodhead Industries posts record Q2 net. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]

text.p: Woodhead Industries Inc said Thursday strong domestic demand for its products resulted in record sales and earnings in the second quarter ended March 29.
The company reported net income of $3.1 million, or $0.28 a share, compared to $2.6 million, or $0.24, one year ago. Sales in the period rose to $35.5 million from $31.7 million, Woodhead said.
Company officials also said new products and cost reduction programs helped gross profit margins increase to 45.1 (corrects from 44.1) percent from 44.3 percent in the first quarter of 1996.
Woodhead makes specialty electrical devices, custom copper and fiber optic cable assemblies and motion control products.
Its shares closed unchanged Thursday at 15-3/8.
